MISE№ 34

Cast-Iron Rosemary Focaccia

Serves 8  ·  Prep 20m  ·  Proof 2h  ·  Bake 25m
Ingredients
400 gBread flour320 gWarm water8 gFine salt7 gInstant yeast3 tbspOlive oil + more for the pan2 sprigsRosemaryto finishFlaky salt
mise.co · turn over for method →
Method
1Mix — Whisk flour, salt and yeast. Add the warm water and 2 tbsp oil; stir to a shaggy, sticky dough.2First proof — Cover and leave somewhere warm ~2 h, until doubled and bubbled.3Oil the skillet — Pour 1 tbsp oil into a 10-inch cast-iron skillet; turn the dough into it.4Dimple & rest — Oil your fingers; press deep dimples all over. Rest 20 min while the oven heats.5Finish — Drizzle with oil, tuck in rosemary sprigs, and scatter over flaky salt.6Bake — 220°C / 430°F for 25 min, until deep gold. Cool 10 min before cutting.
Notes
No cast iron? A cake tin works — add two minutes. Best after an overnight cold proof.
